description: List this account's credits (AWS Activate and promotional credits read from the provider, plus credits entered by hand for sources that expose no grant totals, such as GCP), with balances, burn rate and projected exhaustion, and per source whether credits could be read at all. Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/credits. Presentation and forecast only: budgets, spend limits and anomaly detection count gross spend and ignore credits. Each credit carries its own `currency` with `base_*` amounts in USD; check which one a figure is in before quoting it. `source` says whether a credit was read from the provider ("provider") or entered by hand ("manual"); only manual credits can be removed with delete_credit.
name: list_credits
